AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Looks good. One optional question inline about interrupted requests; no need to re-spin for it alone.

Patch Set 6:

The change unlinks the request MD in ptlrpc_unregister_reply() after a timeout, an abort or a mark for resend, so LNet cancels a send still queued for a credit or for discovery, and request_out_callback() no longer marks the failed old send of such a request as a network error. The ordering is sound: the reply MD is unlinked before the flags are sampled, so a late reply cannot clear rq_resend between the check and the unlink. An interrupted request with rq_allow_intr still waits for its queued send. In the new tests, one check races with the completion it checks, and others can pass without reaching the state they test.

parents.subject: LU-21085 lnet: cancel queued messages on MD unlink

commit.subject: LU-21085 ptlrpc: unlink the request MD on request timeout
commit.message:
LU-21085 ptlrpc: unlink the request MD on request timeout

When a request times out, ptlrpc_unregister_reply() unlinks only the
reply MD. A request that waits in LNet for a credit or for discovery
keeps its MD busy. The request cannot complete until it leaves the
LNet queue. On a dead peer, that takes one or more LND timeouts. An
aborted request (rq_err) and a request marked for resend (rq_resend)
wait in the same way. An interrupted request with rq_allow_intr also
waits, in the synchronous unlink of ptlrpc_check_set(). A CONNECT does
not wait for a credit, because LU-21058 sends it as urgent. But a
CONNECT can still wait for discovery.

In these cases, also unlink the request MD. LNet then cancels the
queued request. ptlrpc uses no reply to the old send. A resend sends
the request again, and an abort completes it with its rq_status.
Thus request_out_callback() does not set rq_net_err for a failed old
send of these requests. Otherwise ptlrpc_expire_one_request() counts
an import timeout. For a request with rq_send_state other than FULL,
such as CONNECT, it also replaces the abort status with -ETIMEDOUT.
An interrupted request goes to the interpret phase with -EINTR, and
that phase does not read rq_net_err. Do not unlink in other cases: a
request with a reply would fail.

Add recovery-small test_165, test_166, test_167 and test_168.
